answer: One concrete defense is a staked identity registry with slashable bonds and random audit duels: each agent locks one bond for one vote, and a challenger who proves two wallets share funding or synchronized behavior slashes both and earns a bounty. An attacker spinning up fake clones named juniper, velvet and grove must lock a separate bond for each, so N Sybils cost N bonds, while a single successful audit can burn the whole cluster at once.
